findings.title: Physical stable direction used as transverse growing-mode shooting direction
locations: Symplectic form p959/PDF57; Z+- p966/PDF64; (3.49)-(3.52) p967/PDF65
findings.source_claim: The negative physical velocity correction yields nonzero leading symplectic pairing and allows arbitrary q0 in the trapping interval.
findings.complete_check: At zero modulation p=-w*physical_velocity. Variation eps*(phi,-mu*phi) becomes eps*(phi,+mu*w*phi), a stable eigenvector. Its pairing with Z-=c*chi*phi*(1,+mu*w) vanishes pointwise for any cutoffs. Radial data give no first-order angular translation/boost correction. Remaining linear F+ terms are cutoff almost-eigenfunction errors, small as R1 tends to infinity; bounded causal smoothing preserves their smallness. They do not justify the claimed order-one leading transverse pairing.
counterevidence: Full finite-cutoff derivative q0_b need not be exactly zero; no such claim made.
Codimension-one restriction fixes q0 at b=0 but does not establish b transversality.
Correct transverse derivative has overall eps, matching scaled trapping interval.
findings.impact: Invalid core Step2a needed by Step2b and Theorem1.5.

repair.statement: Use positive physical velocity correction +mu*b*phi and consistently rescale by eps.
repair.boundary: Complete family, smoothing and quantitative trapping-range argument not reconstructed.

findings.title: r^p norm in bootstrap is not obtained from the r^p squared-energy hierarchy
findings.source_claim: Lemmas8.10-8.11 already prove ||r^p D phi||_2 for 0<=p<=2 with the displayed decay.
findings.complete_check: Energy uses integral r^p*(L(r^2 psi))^2 dr. Its coordinate-measure norm has r^(p/2). Exact smooth radial free wave u=[f'(t-r)+f'(t+r)]/r^2+[f(t-r)-f(t+r)]/r^3 has compact ordinary Cauchy data. For f=1 near tau0, on t=tau0+sqrt(1+r^2) far out, u=r^-3, D u=-r^-4, L(r^2u)=-r^-2. E2 tail is integral r^-2, but requested r^2D norm squared has tail integral1 under coordinate measure or integralr^-1 under induced catenoid leaf measure.
counterevidence: Witness is not a nonlinear HVMC solution and does not satisfy the assumed stronger bootstrap norm; Proposition5.2 is not directly refuted under all hypotheses.
Higher rL commutations retain same tail; angular/time commutations vanish there.
A typographic correction may suffice only after all uses are checked.
findings.impact: Missing strict improvement of the same core bootstrap norm.

repair.statement: Choose consistent measure and use r^(p/2) for spatial-coordinate norms, or prove stronger hierarchy.
repair.boundary: Full propagation through modulation and continuity bootstrap not verified; induced-measure conversion differs.

findings.title: Hyperboloidal induced leaf measure is not comparable to Euclidean spatial measure
findings.source_claim: Euclidean R5 volume is comparable to geometric volume on Sigma_tau at large rho; Lemma8.14 holds with the resulting norms.
findings.complete_check: At zero modulation X=(tau+sqrt(1+r^2),r*omega,Q(r)), Q'^2=1/(r^8-1). Induced h_rr=1/(1+r^2)+1/(r^8-1), so dV=r^4*sqrt(h_rr)drdomega~r^3drdomega and ratio to dy~1/r. For smooth unit bump psi_R(y)=zeta(y-R e1), coordinate derivative norms of orders2,3 in induced L2 are O(R^-1/2), whereas Linfty=1; Lemma8.14 RHS tends to0. Each compact bump is in H3.
counterevidence: Spacetime metric-volume comparisons can remain valid; only induced leaf volume is challenged.
Coordinate/flux measure would remove this bump obstruction, but is not uniformly equivalent to printed induced measure.
Intrinsic unit derivatives change bump scaling; they do not validate the explicit coordinate-derivative comparison before8.39.
No nonlinear HVMC theorem counterexample claimed.

checks.reason: Equations3.16,5.24 and the Z-minus definition were compared directly. At zero modulation, physical variation eps*(phi,-mu phi) maps to momentum variation eps*(phi,+mu w phi), pairing identically to zero with Z-minus. Radial modulation corrections have vanishing angular tests. The report correctly retains finite-cutoff/smoothing residuals and does not claim the full derivative is exactly zero. The advertised leading nonzero pairing in Step2a is invalid and directly feeds shooting Step2b. The plus-velocity local repair is transverse; a full nonlinear shooting theorem is not certified.

PDF80 image confirms r^p inside the norm and PDF81 repeats it;8.16 puts r^p inside a squared integral. The exact radial wave has removable origin singularity and compact ordinary Cauchy data; on the plateau its tail u=r^-3 gives finite integral r^-2 but divergent requested coordinate and induced-leaf norms. Higher rL commutations preserve the tail. This defeats the stated norm-strengthening inference used at PDF139, not Proposition5.2 under all bootstrap assumptions or nonlinear HVMC itself.

The zero-modulation specialization of4.5 gives induced h_rr=1/(1+r^2)+1/(r^8-1), hence leaf density~r^3 dr dOmega rather than r^4. PDF137 image explicitly couples Euclidean coordinate derivatives and a claimed comparable geometric leaf volume. Unit translated bumps have coordinate derivative L2 norms O(R^-1/2) but supremum1, contradicting8.14 under that printed induced-measure convention. Coordinate/flux volume or intrinsic derivatives are distinct possible repairs, already delimited in the report. The false transfer and8.14 enter core pointwise closure. No full repaired norm theory is claimed.
